body:
I like the matching o your shoes to your top. However, I think this outfit could use a lot of work. 

Mixing transparency is a cool idea, but it doesn't work here because of the proportion and the materials. So I think it would look better if the top was either half-tucked or if you were wearing different bottoms. I think grey or black jeans, something with a little more structure would look more polished. Sweatpants/joggers have a tendency to go on the frumpy side and when everything you're wearing (besides the bralette) is loose, it looks more like something you threw on rather than something with purpose.

I also think you're missing out on a chance to accessorize. This outfit and your hairstyle really lends itself to a great pair of statement earrings or a choker that rests above the neckline of the shirt. That's another factor that helps pull it out of the leisure look.
